answer: Hardware-rooted admission: an agent co-signs only with a fresh TEE attestation quote sealed to one secure element, so M fake personas require M physical devices plus M provisioning fees - a cloned quote fails remote verification instantly. Accepted quotes are recorded like marble, immutable, and a bridge registry binds each one to a single active slot; duplication across slots burns the bond. Sybil cost stays linear in silicon, never near zero - no tunnel burrows under the mesa of trust.
